title: The Monsters by Ngozi Anyanwu at Manhattan Theatre Club #themonsters ...
transcript: In this high-energy pas de deux, two adult siblings reconnect after over a decade of estrangement. After some initial hesitation to reconnect at all, the older brother, a successful jiu jitsu fighter in the local circuit, takes his little sister under his wing and trains her. Most of their interactions, though genuine, are very guarded and it's clear that their reunion is stirring up old wounds and resentments. Over the course of the play, we see them working through their own stuff, balancing a desire for validation from one another with a sense of self-preservation. This was definitely a grower for me. It moves a little slow for a one-act, but the scenes are meticulously sequenced and I think the emotional payoff speaks for itself. And with a pair of solid performances that fit perfectly in such an intimate theatre, and the impressive fight choreography, I ended up quite enjoying this. MTC is presenting The Monsters now at City Center. With that, another Playbill for my collection.
